propositions: Accepted /rerun and recheck-review requests are enqueued only in process-local asyncio queue without durable state, causing loss after process restart while stale Gerrit votes and dedup rows remain.
Reconciliation checks local voted state before Gerrit, skipping revisions with stale dedup entries that correspond to already-voted changes in Gerrit.

The approved design resets the exact revision to neutral LLM-Review:0 via Gerrit before acknowledging acceptance, emitting a fresh comment-added event with patchSet fields as the durable recovery marker.
Reconciliation must query Gerrit before local dedup; finding no nonzero vote calls clear_voted for the stale row, then proceeds to vote; Gerrit read errors preserve dedup and hold the cursor back.

Contributor-submitted recheck-review and /rerun requests must not influence the label value; only privileged-side reset operations write fixed neutral 0, and affirmative/refusal replies remain label-free.
Stateful integration test proves recovery: after process loss discards the old queue, one reconcile pass consumes the reset-emitted event and casts exactly one new vote for the same revision.
